items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIzMDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aabdae48f4634a533bea2176b824436ff472d06d/GLC-logo%20cropped.png) This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2027. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MjM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d094d9f0ae39cbbc76dac942c447b3fcd65b2323/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png) Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.
